title: TikTok Scraper Actor
description: Scrapes TikTok videos, profiles, and hashtags using session cookies. Uses network interception to capture data directly from TikTok's API without DOM parsing.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.description: Usernames (with or without @) to scrape as profile feeds. Non-empty entries are queued as profile-feed jobs. Used by red-pharmatiq-api's POST /api/scrape/tiktok/profile.

hashtags.title: Hashtags / Keywords
hashtags.description: The field red-pharmatiq-api actually sends brand keywords in. Unlike clockworks/tiktok-scraper (which OR-matches these as hashtags via the challenge feed), this actor strips a leading '#' and runs each as a real TikTok keyword search for better precision.

resultsPerPage.title: Results Per Page
resultsPerPage.description: clockworks/tiktok-scraper-compatible alias for maxItems (used when maxItems is not set).

sessionCookies.title: Session Cookies
sessionCookies.description: TikTok session cookies in one of these formats: 1) Raw Cookie header string, 2) JSON array (EditThisCookie/Playwright format), 3) Netscape cookies.txt format. Required fields: sessionid, sessionid_ss, sid_tt, sid_guard. When omitted (e.g. clockworks-compatible callers like red-pharmatiq-api never send this), falls back to the TIKTOK_SESSION_COOKIES Actor environment variable - set that as a Secret env var in Apify Console rather than pasting a real cookie here as a default.

cookiePool.title: Cookie Pool (Multiple Sessions)
cookiePool.description: Multiple cookie sets for rotation. Useful for scaling and avoiding rate limits. When omitted and sessionCookies is also omitted, falls back to the TIKTOK_COOKIE_POOL Actor environment variable (a JSON array string in this same shape).

sortBy.title: Sort Order
sortBy.description: Sort search results by relevance or latest posts.

publishedWithin.title: Published Within
publishedWithin.description: Server-side time filter for search mode: all, 1 day, 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, or 180 days.

dateFrom.title: Date From
dateFrom.description: Only keep posts published on or after this date. Accepts 'YYYY-MM-DD' or an ISO datetime string (e.g. '2025-01-01' or '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Applied client-side to all modes; can be combined with dateTo.

dateTo.title: Date To
dateTo.description: Only keep posts published on or before this date. Accepts 'YYYY-MM-DD' (inclusive, through end of day UTC) or an ISO datetime string. Applied client-side to all modes; can be combined with dateFrom.

language.title: Result Language
language.description: ISO language code used to scope search results (sets the lang URL parameter and the browser locale). Default is 'id' (Indonesian).

includeComments.title: Include Comments
includeComments.description: Whether to scrape comments for each video.

commentsPerPost.title: Comments Per Post
commentsPerPost.description: Maximum number of comments to scrape per video.

downloadMedia.title: Download Media
downloadMedia.description: Whether to download media files to KV store (video URLs expire in ~2 hours).

outputSchema.title: Output Schema
outputSchema.description: 'clockworks' matches clockworks/tiktok-scraper's field names (default - red-pharmatiq-api's payloads never set this field, so it must work with no explicit opt-in). 'compat' matches the legacy Threads-style schema, 'native' is full TikTok data, 'both' includes all fields.

proxyCountryCode.title: Proxy Country Code
proxyCountryCode.description: clockworks/tiktok-scraper-compatible field. 2-letter country code for the residential proxy exit node (e.g. 'ID'). Takes priority over the automatic guess based on the cookies' tt-target-idc.

downloadSubtitlesOptions.title: Download Subtitles
downloadSubtitlesOptions.description: clockworks/tiktok-scraper-compatible field. 'DOWNLOAD_SUBTITLES' downloads TikTok's own closed-caption tracks (when present) and re-hosts them in this run's key-value store so they can be fetched without a TikTok session. Free — does not run paid speech-to-text for videos without subtitles.
